per_key.note: 更新 (4 cells); distinct from mesh_updates.title “mesh更新”, so the two sections cannot be confused; terse heading, no 。.

per_key.note: Accurate; 从下一次`lop update`起生效 is idiomatic; command byte-identical; no space around the code span, per the style guide (no space between CJK and Latin runs). 56 cells.
清理旧安装 (10/29 cells; Sentence case not applicable to Han). 清理 matches house wire.settings usage for cleanup/prune (会话清理); understandable on its own as an on/off switch. Noun: see A1.

per_key.value: 每次更新后自动删除未使用的旧安装，规则同`lop install prune`。
per_key.note: 每次更新后自动删除未使用的旧安装，规则同`lop install prune`。 — 规则同 is more precise than “like” and matches the sidecar (exactly that command’s rules); 自动 is implied by the setting, adds no meaning; 删除 = delete. 61/≈72 cells.

per_key.value: 保留当前、运行中及最新的几个
per_key.note: 运行中 correctly replaces the old 使用中 and matches the help’s 运行中的会话; no leftover in-use sense. Coordination ambiguity remains (A2). 28/≈40 cells.
全部保留；手动清理: accurate terse fragment, no 。; 清理 consistent with the label.
保留的未使用安装数 (18/29 cells): a count of unused installs kept; understandable on its own; 未使用 consistent with the help keys.

per_key.value: 始终保留：当前、上一个和运行中的安装，以及会话或服务登记过的安装。此数值另外决定保留多少个最新的未使用安装。
per_key.note: 始终保留 leads, complete at cell 66/146. All four classes: 当前 (current), 上一个 (previous), 运行中的安装 (running: generic, so it covers the updater and any install a session runs from), 会话或服务登记过的安装 (registered = 登记, not 登录 login). There is no 几个 quantifier, so the coordinated list reads as exhaustive (unlike A2). Second sentence 此数值另外决定保留多少个最新的未使用安装 points to the number field (此数值) and reuses the label term 未使用安装, so it reads as attached. 108 cells.

findings.current: 旧安装 / 未使用安装 / 当前安装 / 上一个安装
findings.problem: Bare 安装 as a countable noun reads slightly verb-like (未使用安装数), and the same concept is 安装代次 in cli.install_help (the `lop install --help` text, incl. prune), which this copy points to (规则同`lop install prune`). Idiom/consistency only, no misreading risk.
findings.suggestion: Optional: 清理旧安装代次 (14 cells), 保留的未使用代次数 (18), …删除未使用的旧安装代次，规则同`lop install prune`。 (65). Keeping 安装 is defensible because the English says 'installs'.

findings.current: 保留当前、运行中及最新的几个
findings.problem: Three modifiers coordinated by 、/及 before one head (的几个) can parse as 'keep a few [installs] that are current/running/newest', which blurs that ALL running installs are kept. Not a dropped fact: the guarantee is stated in full in keep_generations.help. Head noun 安装 elided.
findings.suggestion: 保留当前和运行中的安装及最新几个 (32 cells, within ≈40).
